title: aegilops triuncialis subsp. orientalis
intro: Aegilops triuncialis subsp. orientalis, commonly known as oriental goat's grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The oriental goat's grass exhibits therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues and alleviating respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
